papers.title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
papers.what: Trains one shared Transformer encoder across ECG, PPG and PCG by predicting masked latent cardiac states through a learned delay aligner, so the three sensors mutually supervise a single model, raising frozen-encoder performance across 25 tasks by 8.2, 18.8 and 15.5 AUROC points on PPG, PCG and ECG over the best self-supervised signal baseline.
papers.builds_on: Foundation Models for Biosignals (Gu 2025, 2XWEG7AF); HeAR (Baur 2024, 3LA8GNCU); MAE Theory (Zhang 2023, 6INGKIJV)

papers.title: LLM Agents for Time-Series: A Survey
papers.what: Reorganises the time-series agent literature by task rather than by how a language model is attached to a series, and reports architecture, tool use and memory design as consequences of the task, importing agent-community vocabulary into the forecasting literature.
papers.builds_on: LLMs for TS Survey (Zhang 2024, N2JLZBY3); TS-Agent (Liu 2025, I2CIT4I7); ChatTS (Xie 2025, VSCNJG5J)

papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.authors: Tang, Rashtchian, Vu et al. (Google Research)
papers.what: Separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge and executable skills, consolidating experience into a persistent text wiki that skill updates read from, which beats existing skill-evolution methods and lets skills transfer across model families, sometimes beating self-evolved skills.
papers.builds_on: Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026, BDY3HUCV); Chain-of-Experience (Tu 2026, 2608.18027); ToolkenGPT (Hao 2024, 6RDHVVA2)

papers.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
papers.what: Executes unseen manipulation tasks by taking a human demonstration video as the in-context task specification rather than fine-tuning, and solves the paired-data shortage by synthesising 74.2K matched human-robot pairs from existing robot trajectories.
papers.builds_on: DINO-WM (Zhou 2025, W44RSJJI); Navigation World Models (Bar 2024, JQ7JD8AR); VideoMAE (Tong 2022, 9QCZ3A32)
